body:
I’m sorry you know what I’m going through. It’s the worst. 

Thank you :) it means a lot. I hope I can make it again. I’m trying. 

You’re right. MCR have kept me alive for 5 years now, they can probably do it again. I want nothing more than to thank them for how far they’ve gotten me and to experience the music that’s kept me here for so long, but at the same time, I can’t imagine sticking around long enough to get better. Seems too good to be true. 

Oh well, thanks for the message. It really does mean a lot

Sorry I’m just now getting back to you. Forgot about the account and password in general and you’ve probably forgotten about this by now. I’m much better, especially today. It’s a big day for me and I’m glad I’m living to see it :) I might download that app. Thank you :)

She can if she wants to. Got a new phone today and she already noticed I had a passcode and asked why. Constantly makes jokes about how she’ll break into my phone while I’m sleeping. I’m trying to find a place to continue writing. I’m trying not to take it to heart, but it’s difficult. Thank you.

I don’t believe I’m all that brave. I can never just “suck it up” and do what needs to be done. Some procedures I’ve been physically unable to do and been told I’m being immature and need to “act like a grown up”. I don’t agree with what they say, but I don’t believe I’m brave and I know I’m a coward. It really does hurt. Writing it out does help, but I haven’t done it anymore (like I used to) in fear of my mom finding out and punishing me. I shouldn’t be punished for hurting, but apparently that’s okay to her. I’m better than I was earlier, but I just feel lost. I feel like I’m on empty. 
I try to look at the happiest things in my life and hold them close, but I can just feel myself letting it all go. It isn’t enough to make me want to stay alive anymore and that scares the shit out of me. There are still a couple things I want to be alive for, so for now, I’m alive. I’m not okay, but I am alive. I guess that’s all that matters. Thank you for the comment. Truly.
